visual_action: A slideshow of still images celebrating Democratic politicians' victories in the midterm elections. The first image shows Josh Shapiro, Barack Obama, Joe Biden, and John Fetterman holding hands together on a stage. Subsequent images show Maxwell Frost celebrating with supporters, Maura Healey shaking a hand at a podium, John Fetterman with his family on stage, Wes Moore speaking at a podium, and Catherine Cortez Masto smiling at a podium. Each image has a text overlay describing the achievement.
